material_errors.quote: A subsequent post-only retry encounters the pre-flight-required gate.
material_errors.rationale: If audit_required/run_audit is saved but the subsequent held/run_preflight save fails, the persisted state lacks the run_preflight gate. A retry can reject through PostBroken again; the quoted prediction is unconditional.

limitations: Four public read-only source tasks are development calibration, not held-out user qualification.
Two repetitions per task are not eight independent tasks.
Manual unblinded acceptance is separate from source-key omissions and independent user preference.
Runtime-reported tokens include repeated cached context; billing savings remain unknown.
Client-observed wall time does not isolate native, network, queuing or model work.
Native reply equivalence is transport evidence, not quality or avoided model rounds.
This experiment measures neither mined profile benefit nor applied code-fix correctness.
